title: How do you design a CI/CD pipeline for a .NET and React app?
description: Use GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with separate build, test, and deploy stages.

data.text: Question: How do you design a CI/CD pipeline for a .NET and React app?
Use GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with separate jobs for restore, build, test, and deploy. Gate production on passing tests and approvals.

items: Restore: NuGet and npm cache restore
Build: dotnet build and npm run build
Test: unit tests, integration tests, lint, and e2e
Publish: artifacts for API and frontend
Deploy: staging first, then production with approval

data.code:
name: CI/CD
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with: { dotnet-version: '8.0.x' }
      - run: dotnet restore
      - run: dotnet build --no-restore
      - run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20' }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo Deploy to staging
